description: Implement the core application foundation: TypeScript types, Supabase client singleton, AuthContext, routing scaffold, and all layout/shell components (Sidebar, Header, Layout, ProtectedRoute, LoginPage). This gives the app a working auth shell with navigation before any data pages are built. Depends on FEAT-001 being complete. FEAT-003 depends on this feature's providers and components.
steps: Create src/lib/supabase.ts: import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'; read VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY from import.meta.env with a guard that throws a descriptive error if either is missing; export a typed supabase client singleton. No service-role key is ever used here.

Create src/types/index.ts with these exported interfaces and types: Client { id: string; name: string; company: string; email: string; phone: string; location: string; notes?: string; is_archived: boolean; created_at: string; updated_at: string; }, ProjectStatus type = 'Pending' | 'In Progress' | 'Completed' | 'On Hold', Project { id: string; client_id: string; title: string; description?: string; service: string; budget?: number; start_date?: string; deadline?: string; status: ProjectStatus; created_at: string; updated_at: string; }. Also export a Client type with an optional 'projects' relation field: client?: Client (for joined queries).

Create src/context/AuthContext.tsx: define AuthContextType { user: import('@supabase/supabase-js').User | null; loading: boolean; signIn: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<void>; signOut: () => Promise<void>; }. Create AuthContext with createContext. AuthProvider component: use useState for user and loading; on mount call supabase.auth.getSession() to set initial user; subscribe to supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange to keep user in sync; unsubscribe on cleanup. signIn calls supabase.auth.signInWithPassword and throws on error. signOut calls supabase.auth.signOut. Wrap children. Export useAuth hook that throws if used outside provider.

Create src/components/ProtectedRoute.tsx: reads useAuth(); if loading show a centered spinner div with navy background; if no user, render <Navigate to='/login' replace />; otherwise render <Outlet />.

Create src/components/Sidebar.tsx: a responsive left sidebar. On desktop (md+): fixed 64px-wide collapsed icon-only bar that expands to 240px on hover using CSS transition (group/hover pattern with Tailwind). On mobile: hidden by default, toggled by a prop 'isOpen: boolean' with a slide-in overlay. Background color: navy (#000F33). Logo area at top: 'CD' monogram in gold on desktop collapsed, full 'Connect Digitals' text on expanded. Nav links (using NavLink from react-router-dom for active styling): Dashboard (LayoutDashboard icon), Clients (Users icon), Projects (Briefcase icon). Active link: gold left border + slightly lighter navy background. Bottom: sign-out button calling signOut from useAuth. Icons from lucide-react. Accepts props: isOpen (mobile state) and onClose (mobile close handler).

Create src/components/Header.tsx: top bar for mobile only (hidden md:hidden on desktop). Shows hamburger menu icon (Menu from lucide-react) that calls a prop 'onMenuToggle: () => void'. Shows page title from a prop 'title: string'. Background: navy, text: cream.

Create src/components/Layout.tsx: manages the mobile sidebar open/close state (useState). Renders Header (mobile), Sidebar, and a main content area. The main content area has a cream (#F8F4EF) background, padding, and renders <Outlet />. On mobile when sidebar is open, renders a semi-transparent overlay div that closes sidebar on click.

Update src/index.css: add @import url for Inter font from Google Fonts (https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap) at the top, then @tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities;

Create src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: centered card layout on a navy background. Connect Digitals logo/wordmark at top in gold. Email and password inputs with cream background. 'Sign In' button in brand_red. On submit call signIn from useAuth, show inline error message if it throws. After successful sign-in, navigate to '/'. No signup link — admin-only access. Input validation: both fields required, show error if empty.

Create src/App.tsx: import BrowserRouter, Routes, Route from react-router-dom; import AuthProvider; import all pages and components. Route structure: '/' wraps ProtectedRoute + Layout, with children: index → DashboardPage, '/clients' → ClientsPage, '/projects' → ProjectsPage. '/login' → LoginPage (unprotected). Wrap everything in AuthProvider. Export default App.
Update src/main.tsx: import React, ReactDOM, App, './index.css'; ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(<React.StrictMode><App /></React.StrictMode>).

Run `npm run build` inside agency-ams/ to confirm no TypeScript errors. Stub DashboardPage, ClientsPage, ProjectsPage as empty components returning a
Page name
so routing compiles. Fix any errors.

Layout renders Sidebar + main content area with correct branding colors
AuthContext provides user state that updates on Supabase auth events
